results.agent_message:
Task complete: Fixed two bugs in lru_cache.py that caused `test_put_updates_existing_key_order` to fail:

1. **`get()` didn't update recency** — Added pop-and-reinsert logic so accessing a key moves it to the most-recently-used position.
2. **`put()` on an existing key didn't update recency** — Added a check to pop the key before re-inserting when updating, ensuring it moves to the most-recently-used position.

All 6 tests now pass.
